Rozwój osobisty

Most people do not stay broke because they lack motivation. They stay behind because they were never taught the rules of wealth. The Wealth Gap Is a Knowledge Gap is a direct, practical audiobook that explains seven financial concepts wealthy people understand earlier than everyone else. No hype. No fluff. No empty motivation. Just the information gap between earning money and actually building wealth. Inside, you'll learn the basics of compound interest, tax optimization, asset vs. liability thinking, income diversification, leverage, the difference between income and wealth, and how generational wealth is built and protected.
